ModMetaData.name: 逆重舰队与远航增强 (Gravship Fleet And Voyage Pro)
ModMetaData.author: Estrella6066
ModMetaData.description:
本模组分别优化了Gravship Fleet和Gravship Voyage，会在安装对应mod时自动生效。
【逆重舰队优化】需要 Gravship Fleet：
1. 允许逆重飞船在存在其他逆重引擎的地图起飞时不摧毁地图，但飞船起飞时会撕裂地面，留下一片隆起岩层，并造成塌方。如果地图处于天上，则摧毁飞船原先所处的地形。如果地图有逆重锚，就能避免这些情况。
2. 修复了逆重飞船的组件，在地图中存在多个引擎时，因为判定异常而无法生效的问题。
3. 注意！！！如果只有一艘飞船时起飞，仍然会摧毁没有逆重锚的地图。
4. 和Gravship Voyage一同启用时，纠正飞船电脑核心的判定逻辑，使其判定正确的飞船。
【飞船电脑核心优化】需要 Gravship Voyage：
1. 优化Gravship Voyage提供的人工智能，使其能够更加灵活的指挥机械族。
2. 可以向飞船电脑核心中存入更多机械师植入物，对人工智能进行强化，也可以随时取出这些植入体，用于别处。
3. 针对远程维修等能力，给人工智能提供了10点手工属性。让人工智能在安装植入体后能远程维修机械族。
4. 屋顶下面也能建造飞船电脑核心。
5. 一艘逆重飞船可以同时安装多台电脑核心。
6. 当飞船电脑核心连接到飞船时，会将飞船的逆重引擎和延展器视为信号基站，但电脑核心本身不再提供指挥区域。
7. 当飞船电脑核心连接到飞船时，它的机械族会在保护模式下聚集在它所连接的逆重飞船上,而不是聚集在飞船电脑核心周围。
------------ English ------------
This mod improves Gravship Fleet and Gravship Voyage separately; each half takes effect when the matching mod is installed.
[Fleet improvements] Requires Gravship Fleet:
1. Lets a gravship take off from a map that still holds other grav engines without abandoning that map. The launch tears the ground open instead, leaving a raised slab of rock that then collapses. If the map is in space, the ground the ship stood on is destroyed outright. A grav anchor on the map prevents both.
2. Fixes gravship components that went inert on a map with more than one engine because of a faulty check.
3. Note!!! If the ship lifting off is the only one on the map, a map without a grav anchor is still abandoned.
4. With Gravship Voyage also active, corrects how the ship computer core decides which ship it belongs to, so that it picks the right one.
[Computer core improvements] Requires Gravship Voyage:
1. Improves the AI that Gravship Voyage provides, so it can command mechanoids more flexibly.
2. More mechanitor implants can be stored in the ship computer core to strengthen the AI, and they can be taken back out at any time for use elsewhere.
3. The AI is given 10 Crafting for abilities such as remote repair, so that once an implant is installed it can repair mechanoids at a distance.
4. The ship computer core can be built under a roof.
5. A single gravship can carry more than one computer core.
6. Once the ship computer core is connected to a ship, that ship's grav engines and grav field extenders act as signal relays for it. The core itself no longer provides a command area.
7. Once the ship computer core is connected to a ship, in guard mode its mechanoids gather on the gravship it is connected to rather than around the core itself.
